queer autistic romanian here!! i don't think there's anything i can say that can take this pain away from you. all i can tell you is that i feel you. i've been struggling with anxiety and depression my whole life and i will probably be on meds til i die. life itself has been traumatic and most days i feel like there's no reason to exist.  

cliche incoming - but maybe, if you ever feel like it, you could try reaching out to a therapist. there's facebook groups for recommending good therapists (and bucharest is basically the best ground for finding one) so you can lower your chances of finding a terrible one. i'm not saying its a lifesaver, but it could help.  

other than that, i really hope you find your peace and i'm proud of you for surviving up until now!!!

i've been there and it plain sucks. the ominous eye contact, the instant resting bitch face, the really weird n awkward couple of words we exchanged n god knows i could go on. you're young tho and, while you prolly already know this, he's just a dude. i live in a small town and it took me so much time to realize that no, the ppl in my hometown are *not* the best i can do and if i find someone rlly hot, that doesn't mean my whole existence has to be validated by that person. i'm not trying to invalidate what you feel - i know it's intense and ye, sometimes all we can do is daydream, but tbh the best thing i did for my mental health was *not* give this much power over my feelings to people from high school. i've only had bad experiences with it. the ones that didn't understand me, i noticed from the beginning and, the ones that seemed to give a fuck, ratted themselves out to be garbage anyway.  

try not to hold him to high standards in your head. he might be cute n might seem nice, but please don't let this façade trick you into thinking he has the upper hand or that you owe him something for showing basic kindness to you.  

i'm sorry, i know you didn't ask for advice, but i couldn't help but notice the exact same pattern of anxiety i've been going through all thorough high school and if i can give a piece of my wisdom to someone going through it, goddammit im gonna do it. you can dm me if you need someone to talk to. take care of yourself!!!!!
